title: FragmentReceiver bitmaps array size limits windows to 2
description:
Line 737:
```rust
bitmaps: [u64; 2],
```

The receiver only supports 2 windows (indices 0 and 1). This is validated implicitly via `fragment.window <= 1` in the validation check, but:

1. The constant `2` is hardcoded, not derived from a named constant
2. If WINDOW_SIZE or fragmentation parameters change, this could become inconsistent
3. Line 890-891 uses `.skip(usize::from(fragment.window) + 1)` which assumes the array is exactly 2 elements

Suggested fix: Define a constant `const MAX_WINDOWS: usize = 2;` and use it consistently:
```rust
bitmaps: [u64; MAX_WINDOWS],
```
